Why go: the biggest private party boat in our fleet

The Serenity Max is a 71 ft (21.6 m) power catamaran built for groups. It has a sun deck, a lounge bar with seating, a shaded dining area, several toilets and freshwater showers, and a water slide that runs from the upper deck straight into the sea. With a captain and 5–10 crew it takes up to 60 guests, which makes it the boat for birthdays, weddings, company outings and big family reunions where everyone needs to be on the same boat.

The shortest option is a 2-hour sunset run to a small island off Samui. The 4-hour and 7-hour options cross to Koh Phangan for swimming, snorkelling and time on the slide at anchor. The 9-hour day goes to Ang Thong Marine Park, the 42-island national park west of Samui, from 16 December when the park reopens.

Who it suits, and who should choose something else

It suits groups of 20 or more who want a single, shared space with room to dance, eat and swim. Per head it can cost less than several smaller boats, because the base price already covers 20 guests and extra guests are charged at 800–1,400 THB each.

It is not a quiet sailing day. Power catamarans run on engines the whole way, and a big group makes noise. Couples and small families will get better value and a calmer day on the Orana or a small private boat; see our catamaran charter guide. For a romantic evening for two, our sunset cruise page lists smaller options.

Good to know

  • Ang Thong Marine Park closes every year from 1 November to 15 December. Book the Koh Phangan or sunset options in that window.
  • The slide is used only when the boat is anchored in calm water and the crew say it is safe. Children should wear life jackets in the water.
  • Alcohol is not included and Thai law restricts alcohol sales at certain hours and on Buddhist holidays, so plan party drinks in advance. Read our alcohol rules page.
  • Catering, a DJ and decorations are quoted separately; send your plan on WhatsApp at least a few days before.
